headline: Genome-scale tools refine orthology, annotation and contamination removal
label: Computational Genome Inference Methods
summary: Recent preprints benchmark new orthogroup, annotation, decontamination and search-space methods against established tools in June 2026.
synthesis: The dominant thread is refinement of computational inference from genomic and proteomic data, with new methods benchmarked against established tools. OGGfinder combines sequence similarity, tree-topology constraints and LHS parameter optimization for orthogroup inference, outperforming OrthoFinder, CD-HIT and TreeCluster. FuncZymeDB-BAHD pairs a curated database of 2,705 BAHD acyltransferase activities with FuncPred-OG and FuncPred-AI annotation methods. A consensus pipeline (k-mer/GC, DIAMOND, Kraken2) decontaminates 30 public sponge genome assemblies. MetaPilot uses marker-protein evidence to refine sample-specific search spaces for DDA and DIA metaproteomics. RetroMol encodes natural products and biosynthetic gene clusters with primary sequences, and Genestrip performs memory-efficient k-mer read classification matching KrakenUniq on a regular PC.
